events.title: The Collection, Up Close
events.venue: National Gallery of Art, West Building
events.address: 6th St and Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: A guided close-looking tour that slows down for conversation around selected works from the national collection.

events.title: Italian Renaissance Gallery Tour
events.venue: National Gallery of Art, West Building
events.address: 6th St and Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: A one-hour guided look at Italian Renaissance paintings and their artistic, religious, and historical settings.

events.title: Glimpses of Life in 17th-Century Dutch Art
events.venue: National Gallery of Art, West Building
events.address: 6th St and Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: Explore everyday life, interiors, and visual storytelling through paintings from the Dutch Golden Age collection.

events.title: Back and Forth: Rozeal., Titian, Cezanne Tour
events.address: 4th St and Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: A focused exhibition tour tracing visual dialogue among Rozeal., Titian, and Cezanne across time and style.

events.title: Understanding Modern and Contemporary Art
events.venue: National Gallery of Art, East Building
events.address: 4th St and Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: A conversational gallery tour offering useful ways to approach modern and contemporary works without specialist knowledge.

events.title: Sculpture Garden Tour
events.venue: National Gallery of Art Sculpture Garden
events.address: 7th St and Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: Walk the Sculpture Garden with a guide and consider major outdoor works in their landscaped setting.

events.title: Outdoor Tour of the Capitol Grounds
events.description: A live guide leads an outdoor walk through the architecture, memorials, and landscape of the Capitol grounds.

events.title: Specialty Tour: Halls of the Senate
events.description: A specialty tour explores Senate spaces and traditions, meeting near the Slave Labor Commemorative Marker.

events.title: What Is Happening in the Chambers?
events.description: An education program explains current work in the House and Senate chambers from the Statue of Freedom area.

events.title: Specialty Tour: Remembering the Revolution
events.description: A specialty tour examines how the American Revolution is remembered through Capitol art and interpretation.

events.title: Specialty Tour: Heroes of Civil Rights
events.description: A guided Capitol specialty tour highlights people and stories central to the American civil rights movement.

events.title: Full Moon Fridays Hike and Campfire
events.description: Hike natural-surface trails by moonlight, then gather around a campfire with marshmallows provided by the nature center.

events.title: Adaptive Mountain Biking Group Ride
events.description: An inclusive group trail ride supported by Montgomery Parks' adaptive recreation program and accessible equipment options.

events.title: Campfire Fridays
events.description: A family evening of nature walks, interactive activities, animal presentations, a campfire, and included s'mores.

events.title: Campfire Night Hike: Predators at Night
events.description: Listen for owls and coyotes on a guided nocturnal walk, then finish beside the campfire with s'mores.

events.title: Southern Culture on the Skids
events.description: The long-running North Carolina trio brings its off-center blend of rock, surf, country, and garage energy to the Wharf.

events.title: Mastodon with Deafheaven and Alcest
events.description: A heavy triple bill pairs Grammy-winning progressive metal band Mastodon with Deafheaven and French post-metal band Alcest.

events.title: The Matches: Decomposer 20 Years Later
events.description: The Matches mark two decades of Decomposer with support from Crooked Teeth at the Black Cat.

events.title: SYML with Katelyn Tarver
events.description: Seattle songwriter Brian Fennell brings the intimate, atmospheric SYML project with opener Katelyn Tarver.

events.title: Come From Away
events.description: The Tony Award-winning musical returns with the true story of Gander welcoming stranded airline passengers after 9/11.

events.title: Chicago Crossings: Bridges and Boundaries and A Good Man
events.address: 4th St and Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: A paired documentary screening examines Chicago communities, boundaries, civic life, and the work of an artist-educator.

events.title: Outdoor Guided Walk for Families: Birds
events.description: A youth educator leads families through garden birding hotspots with interactive discussion and close observation.

events.title: Campfire 101
events.age: Ages 8+; adult must register with child
events.description: Learn log-stacking methods, fire-lighting techniques, and practical fire safety with a park naturalist.

events.title: Woodlawn Manor Guided Twilight Trek
events.description: Walk two miles by twilight while learning the nighttime navigation methods and challenges faced by freedom seekers.

events.title: Public Lands Day Invasive Plant Pull
events.age: Ages 3+; parent required for 13 and under
events.description: Celebrate National Public Lands Day by helping park staff remove invasive plants and restore wildlife habitat.

events.title: Bird Walk With a Naturalist
events.description: Beginners and experienced birders use sight and sound to identify native birds with a park naturalist.

events.title: Nature Walk With a Police Officer
events.description: Families investigate logs and forest-floor habitats with a naturalist and a Fairfax police community outreach officer.

events.title: Making Ice and Ice Cream at Walney
events.description: Hand-crank ice cream while learning how a 19th-century farm harvested and stored ice and used period ice tools.

events.title: Planet Adventure Night
events.description: Tour the visible planets and moons, then observe through telescopes from the roll-top observatory, weather permitting.

events.title: Fall Tea Party at the Mill
events.address: 10017 Colvin Run Road, Great Falls, VA 22066
events.description: Celebrate fall with tea, savory and sweet treats, and 19th-century games at a working historic mill site.

events.title: Folklore and Campfire
events.address: 10017 Colvin Run Road, Great Falls, VA 22066
events.description: Gather under the stars for American folktales reflecting varied cultures and customs, followed by toasted marshmallows.

events.title: Twilight Hilltop Tour

events.title: Old Tavern Horse Trials: Day 1
events.address: 5089 Old Tavern Road, The Plains, VA 20198
events.description: Watch riders and horses compete in a high-performance eventing meet amid the rolling landscape of Virginia hunt country.

events.title: Great Meadow Polo Summer Series
events.address: 5089 Old Tavern Road, The Plains, VA 20198
events.description: Tailgate beside fast-paced arena polo in Virginia horse country; gates open at 5:30 and play starts at 7.

events.title: Satin Jackets
events.description: German producer Tim Bernhardt brings the warm, polished disco-house sound of Satin Jackets to a late-night set.

events.title: Joshua Radin with Amber Rubarth
events.description: Singer-songwriter Joshua Radin performs his intimate folk-pop catalog with support from Amber Rubarth.

events.title: Gorillaz: The Mountain Tour 2026
events.description: Gorillaz combine a powerhouse live band, genre-crossing songs, animated characters, and large-scale visual production.

events.title: Fiesta DC Festival: Saturday

events.description: Rangers connect stars to American history, then help visitors find constellations, Andromeda, and Saturn by telescope.

events.title: Paper Made: Artists' Inventive Explorations
events.address: 4th St and Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: A concise gallery conversation explores how artists transform paper into an expressive fine-art medium.

events.title: Life Itself
events.address: 4th St and Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: A National Gallery screening of the acclaimed documentary portrait of film critic Roger Ebert and his extraordinary life.

events.title: Native Plant Propagation Workshop
events.description: Take a deeper dive into growing native plants from seeds and cuttings and the conditions young plants need to thrive.

events.title: Parks Half Marathon
events.venue: Beach Drive and Rock Creek Regional Park
events.description: A sunrise half marathon moves from a scenic county road into wooded Rock Creek Park and finishes with a festival.

events.title: Monarch Tag and Tea

events.title: Practical Plants: Foraging for Herbal Remedies
events.address: 8700 Potomac Hills Street, Great Falls, VA 22066
events.description: Learn to identify Virginia wild edibles and traditional herbal remedies and gather them safely and sustainably.

events.title: Junior Forest Foragers
events.address: 8700 Potomac Hills Street, Great Falls, VA 22066
events.description: Young naturalists learn sustainable foraging, identify edible and medicinal plants, and make a seasonal creation.

events.title: Family Fishing
events.description: A naturalist teaches fishing basics and responsible recreation at the lakefront, with rods and bait provided.

events.title: Grit and Grain: African American Millers
events.address: 10017 Colvin Run Road, Great Falls, VA 22066
events.description: Explore a historic gristmill while discussing the essential labor and expertise of African American millers in Fairfax County.

events.title: Armand Hammer with Curly Castro
events.description: The acclaimed rap duo brings sharp, historically minded lyricism to Union Stage with Curly Castro opening.

events.title: Sawyer Hill with Never Ending Fall
events.description: Arkansas rocker Sawyer Hill brings the Everybody's Home, Nobody's Happy tour with local support Never Ending Fall.

events.title: Come From Away
events.description: The Tony Award-winning musical tells how a Newfoundland town welcomed thousands of stranded passengers after 9/11.

events.title: Max Amini Live in Washington DC
events.description: Comedian Max Amini brings his fast-moving live show and cross-cultural observational comedy to Constitution Hall.

events.title: Old Tavern Horse Trials: Day 2
events.address: 5089 Old Tavern Road, The Plains, VA 20198
events.description: Day two continues the horse trials with riders and equine partners competing at Great Meadow's Fleming Farm grounds.

events.title: Fiesta DC Festival: Sunday
events.address: Pennsylvania Avenue NW between 3rd and 7th Streets, Washington, DC
events.description: The Latino cultural festival continues Sunday with live performance, food, dance, artisan vendors, and community celebration.
